Attune 0.0.14 adds native Linux packages for x64 and ARM64, including Fedora Asahi.

Linux releases now include RPM and DEB installers with a desktop launcher. The ARM64 build compiles the pinned Kindling converter from source.

GTK 3, WebKitGTK 4.1, and libmtp remain system runtime dependencies and are resolved by the package manager during installation.
